subtitle:2:1511259001:.text: Time moves at the same rate on both sides of the portal. Every second here is a second there...
subtitle:2:1511259001:.source_cn: 时空门的另一侧，时间同步流逝……

cinematic_dialogue:2:1511259002:.text: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>, if it fails, call for me...

say:4:1511260001:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you disappeared again just now! Did you go another time?

narration:8:1511260004:1.text: You even show them the softplumes Tilaya gave you... a small gift that now feels like a symbol of your entire journey.

say:11:1511260005:0.text: Does this mean the ancestors of the Wilders were part of the Wildborn tribe?
say:11:1511260005:0.source_cn: 这样说来，难道生活在薄暮丛林的绿裔的先祖，也是雅库伯尔人？

choice_prompt:12:1511260005.text: Does this mean the ancestors of the Wilders were part of the Wildborn tribe?

say:13:1511260006:0.text: Gods... that means the Maulers and Wilders were once one tribe!
say:13:1511260006:0.source_cn: 天哪……蛮血居然可能和绿裔有同一个先祖！

say:14:1511260007:1.text: The portal is sealed. The echoes have faded.
say:14:1511260007:1.source_cn: 门已经封印，回声也已消失。

say:15:1511260008:0.text: I will go inform the priestesses of this matter.
say:15:1511260008:0.source_cn: 我前去将此事告知祭司。告辞。

say:17:1511260009:1.text: Are you okay, Merlin? Do you need to take a break?
say:17:1511260009:1.source_cn: 梅林，你还好吗？需不需要跟我们回去休息一下？
say:17:1511260009:1.male: Are you okay, Merlin? Do you need to take a break?
say:17:1511260009:1.female: Are you okay, Merlin? Do you need to take a break?

say:18:1511260010:1.text: Yes, you look pale. You definitely need rest.
say:18:1511260010:1.source_cn: 是啊，你脸色很不好，看起来需要好好睡上一觉才行。
say:18:1511260010:1.male: Yes, you look pale. You definitely need rest.
say:18:1511260010:1.female: Yes, you look pale. You definitely need rest.

say:19:1511260011:1.text: You're about to agree, but your gaze suddenly falls upon the <style="highlight">softplumes</style> in your hands.
